subject: RepositoryEstateService — Lane T3 released boundary
released_boundary: RepositoryEstateService: typed application service that registers local repositories, emits append-only content-light repository observation evidence, detects observable state changes truthfully, and produces reconstructable projections for later PostgreSQL and Gridline consumption.
stated_consumer_purpose: A later integration lane can persist repository-estate projections through the PostgreSQL operational data plane and render real Repository Estate state in the native desktop app.

authority_bypass.attack_result: REFUTED. All product actions enter through RepositoryEstateService — a typed application service. No CLI entry point, no tool wrapper, no frontend path exists.
authority_bypass.evidence: tests/repository_estate/test_service.py — all 25 tests exercise the real application-service boundary.

content_leak.claim: Private source content or raw paths leak into evidence/projection.
content_leak.attack_result: REFUTED. root_path_digest is SHA256 of the resolved path. repository_hash is compound SHA256. git_facts contains only counts, digests, and labels. instruction_files contain only kind, path_digest, content_sha256. dirty_counts are pure integers. remotes contain url_digest not raw URLs.
content_leak.evidence: test_observation_has_no_raw_file_content explicitly verifies '# Agent instructions' and 'def hello()' are absent from observation payload. test_registration_has_no_raw_paths verifies 'root_path' field does not exist.

false_authorization.claim: Observation is falsely represented as authorization.
false_authorization.attack_result: REFUTED. Observation is explicitly read-only (git --no-optional-locks). No mutation capability is attached. ObservationStatus enum has no 'authorized' value.
false_authorization.evidence: rig_relay/repository_estate/_service.py uses resolve_git_*() from digestion/identity.py which enforces --no-optional-locks.

false_change.claim: Duplicate observations create false change events.
false_change.attack_result: REFUTED. test_repeated_unchanged_observation_is_deterministic proves unchanged status. Change detection is based on actual git fact comparison via _detect_changes_direct().
false_change.evidence: tests/repository_estate/test_service.py tests for unchanged, changed, dirty, branch change, detached HEAD.

evidence_reconstruction.claim: Append-only evidence cannot reconstruct the projection.
evidence_reconstruction.attack_result: REFUTED. build_projection() reads from append-only JSONL files and reconstructs a deterministic projection. test_projection_from_evidence proves reconstruction.

fake_git_tests.claim: Tests use fake Git repositories or mocks.
fake_git_tests.attack_result: REFUTED. All tests use real git init on temp directories. No mocks, no stubs, no ghosts. Conforms to 'NO MOCKS. NO STUBS. NO GHOSTS' doctrine.

cross_lane_breach.claim: Lane secretly wires through unpublished T2 or edits live frontend/gateway boundary.
cross_lane_breach.attack_result: REFUTED. No files in rig_relay/desktop/gateway/ were modified. No files in rig_relay/data_plane/postgres/ were modified. Only a PLR per-file-ignore was added to pyproject.toml.
cross_lane_breach.evidence: git diff shows only T3-owned files: rig_relay/repository_estate/*, tests/repository_estate/*, docs/schemas/rig.relay.repository_estate_*.json, docs/json/audits/repository_estate/*, pyproject.toml (PLR exemption only).

publication_integrity.claim: Remote pushed slice does not support the stated release.
publication_integrity.attack_result: PENDING_VERIFICATION. Will verify SHA after push. Local tests all pass (25/25). Ruff + pyright clean.
publication_integrity.evidence: pytest: 25 passed. ruff: all checks passed. pyright: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
